offence_note: Criminal contempt for breaching pipeline injunction
note: Only application to appoint counsel for appeals; sentences of 28, 45, 90 days below not decided here.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm by stabbing
sentence_quote: the sentence that I am imposing is a conditional discharge. I am making the conditions in the terms of a probation order
note: Firearms prohibition 10 years; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking cocaine, simple possession, obstructing peace officer
sentence_quote: I am going to impose on you a conditional sentence of imprisonment. It is to be served in the community, for 18 months, with six further months of probation on the same terms.
note: Joint submission accepted; lifetime firearms prohibition; curfew terms.

offence_note: Armed robbery of a pharmacy for narcotics
sentence_quote: replaced with a three-year custodial term. The pre-sentence custody of four and a half months remains the same, but is in addition to the three-year custodial term.
note: Five-year sentence replaced by three years plus 4.5 months pre-sentence custody; victim surcharge set aside.

offence_note: Robbery of thrift store; wearing face mask with intent
sentence_quote: I sentence the accused to a period of four year imprisonment on Count 2 and three months concurrent on Count 3.
note: 19 months pre-trial custody credited 2:1; co-accused got conditional sentences, disparity considered; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Possession for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: the sentence for possession for the purposes is reduced to eighteen months imprisonment. The probation order is set aside.
note: Trial effective sentence 27 months reduced to 18 months; probation set aside.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm, failing to stop at accident, threats, probation breach
sentence_quote: The extension of time is granted. Leave to appeal is granted and the appeal is dismissed.
note: Appeal only sought enhanced pre-sentence credit; sentence of 2 years plus 3 years probation plus credited time stands.

offence_note: Second degree murder by a youth sentenced as adult
sentence_quote: sentenced the appellant to life imprisonment with no eligibility for parole for seven years. He ordered that the appellant serve the first two years of his sentence in a youth facility
note: Adult sentence imposed on 17-year-old; first two years in youth facility.

offence_note: Criminal harassment and breaches of court orders
sentence_quote: sentence imposed on that charge of fifteen months in custody plus three months pre-trial custody
note: Joint submission of nine months rejected at trial; rejection upheld.
